pixel_identity.hash: SHA-256 of dtype, shape, and contiguous decoded bytes

d4.definition: np.fliplr(np.rot90(a, k)) for k=0,1,2,3; hflip is applied after rotation; no interpolation
d4.canonical_hash: lexicographic minimum of the eight operation-specific pixel SHA-256 values
d4.pair_transforms: all operations for which transform(A) has the same pixel hash as original B

descriptors_private_only.image_thumbnail: 32x32 grayscale PIL BILINEAR descriptor for each D4 orientation; not a transformed training input
descriptors_private_only.gt_thumbnail: 32x32 float32 OpenCV INTER_AREA descriptor for each D4 orientation; retrieval only, never a reannotation
descriptors_private_only.phash: 64 bits from the 8x8 lowest-frequency DCT-II coefficients excluding DC, threshold at their median; 32x32 descriptor
descriptors_private_only.dhash: 64 bits from horizontal differences on a 9x8 OpenCV INTER_AREA descriptor
descriptors_private_only.storage: private NPZ outside the public Git repository; no image or GT arrays in public outputs

candidate_retrieval.lsh: four independent indexes: image-pHash, image-dHash, GT-pHash, GT-dHash; four 16-bit bands per 64-bit oriented hash; all eight orientations are indexed
candidate_retrieval.additional_seeds: all exact image-D4 and exact GT-D4 pairs
candidate_retrieval.overflow_policy: record overflow and downgrade FULL DATASET TRANSFORM SCREEN to PARTIAL; do not silently discard

review_gate.image_rule: (min_image_phash<=16 AND min_image_dhash<=24 AND thumbnail_pearson>=0.85) OR (min_image_phash<=10 AND thumbnail_pearson>=0.80) OR (min_image_dhash<=10 AND thumbnail_pearson>=0.88) OR thumbnail_pearson>=0.965
review_gate.exact_gt_d4: always fully reviewed and exempt from review caps
review_gate.priority_samples: all pairs consisting solely of the eight priority records are exempt from review caps
review_gate.ordering: descending max(image thumbnail Pearson, GT thumbnail foreground IoU), then ascending summed minimum Hamming distance, then record keys; no split or outcome preference
review_gate.cap_policy: save every retrieved pair and its filtering/cap reason; any triggered cap downgrades the near-duplicate screen to PARTIAL

full_alignment_review.candidate_orientations: best image-hash orientation, best GT-hash orientation, and every exact image/GT D4 orientation
full_alignment_review.image_metrics: RGB Pearson, RGB MAE, RGB PSNR, grayscale Pearson, grayscale MAE, grayscale PSNR, grayscale SSIM
full_alignment_review.ssim: skimage.metrics.structural_similarity on 8-bit grayscale with data_range=255, win_size=7, gaussian_weights=False, use_sample_covariance=True, K1=0.01, K2=0.03
full_alignment_review.gt_metrics: pixel agreement, nonzero foreground IoU, present-class macro IoU, exact differing-pixel count
full_alignment_review.constant_input_rule: Pearson is null for a constant vector; PSNR is Infinity only for zero MSE and null for undefined inputs

classification_thresholds_retrospective.image_high_similarity: RGB Pearson>=0.990 AND RGB MAE<=6.0 AND RGB PSNR>=24.0 AND grayscale SSIM>=0.95 under one D4 alignment
classification_thresholds_retrospective.image_near_only: RGB Pearson>=0.950 AND RGB MAE<=12.0 AND grayscale SSIM>=0.80 under one D4 alignment
classification_thresholds_retrospective.gt_near_similarity: foreground IoU>=0.95 AND pixel agreement>=0.995 under one D4 alignment; exact GT-D4 is recorded separately

family_rules.transform_equivalence: join only exact image-D4 edges, never GT-only edges
family_rules.high_confidence_candidate: join exact image-D4 edges and fully reviewed image-high-similarity edges; GT-D4 plus high image similarity is sufficient, GT-only similarity is not
family_rules.acquisition_proven: requires an explicit upstream acquisition ID or generation record linking derivatives; repository path, hash, correlation, and visual appearance alone do not qualify
family_rules.transitivity: no transitive closure of low-threshold or unreviewed candidates

positive_controls.rotation_gt_controls: test:000301 and test:000305 must each have three non-mirrored rotation-exact GT partners among train:001281/001285/002151/002155/003021/003025; six unique cross-split pairs in total
positive_controls.failure_policy: stop before near-duplicate conclusions if any control fails

independence_status_rule.COMPROMISED: at least one exact decoded-image or exact image-D4 relation crosses train/test
independence_status_rule.HIGH_RISK_CANDIDATE: no exact image cross-split edge, but at least one fully reviewed high-confidence candidate crosses train/test
independence_status_rule.VERIFIED: not assigned by this retrospective screen; absence of detected candidates is not acquisition-level proof
independence_status_rule.UNRESOLVED: no exact or high-confidence cross-split relation is detected

not_run: new metric evaluation on model predictions
